PDF N-Up Imposer

Fit 2, 4 or 9 PDF pages onto each sheet — save paper when printing slides, drafts and handouts.

–
Source pages
–
Sheets
–
Output size

Pages keep their aspect ratio — they are scaled, never stretched. Everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file.
  2. Pick 2-up, 4-up or 9-up.
  3. Optionally show page numbers on each cell.
  4. Click "Impose" and download the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the pages arranged?

2-up stacks 2 pages vertically, 4-up is a 2×2 grid, 9-up is a 3×3 grid — all on portrait sheets the size of your source pages.

Are pages stretched to fit?

Yes — each page is scaled to fit its cell with its aspect ratio preserved, so nothing is stretched.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No — imposition happens entirely in your browser.
